ld.description: Mild By Nature Nourishing Body Wash, Coconut Bergamot Shea Butter, Coconut, and Sweet Almond Oils Chamomile, Grape Seed, and Olive Leaf Extracts pH Balanced and Cruelty-Free For Silky Soft, Healthier-Looking Skin Formulated Without Sulfates, Parabens or Phthalates Made in the USA with Globally Sourced Materials Cleanse and nourish the skin with one simple step. Mild By Nature Nourishing Body Wash helps your skin feel clean and smooth with moisturizing ingredients like shea butter, as well as nourishing vitamin E to help protect the skin. This unique formula also features chamomile, grape seed, and olive leaf extracts to help you achieve silky, soft, healthier-looking skin. Our Coconut Bergamot body wash is infused with coconut and sweet almond oils for a light, refreshing scent that awakens the senses and helps soothe dry skin. Help your skin stay clean and moisturized by using this nourishing body wash daily.
